title: bridge-atlas-bc7-cache-generation
userStory: As a mod developer using the ImageManagementBridge, I want my registered atlases to also benefit from BC7 caching so that my mod's images load faster on subsequent game starts.
background: Currently only local image folder atlases (LoadImagesFromLocalFoldersCoroutine) write BC7 cache files. Atlases registered via ImageManagementBridge (RegisterImageAtlas with file paths, or RegisterImageAtlasFromMemory with a producer function) go through EnqueueModAtlasLoader -> RegisterAtlas(ModAtlases) without any cache write. We need to add WriteBC7CacheAndReplaceTextures after RegisterAtlas in EnqueueModAtlasLoader for both types. For file-based atlases the checksum uses ComputeFolderChecksum-style logic (full path + file size, PNG only). For memory-based atlases the checksum uses the new ComputeBridgeMemoryChecksum helper from the checksum task.
implementationNotes: In WEAtlasesLibrary.EnqueueModAtlasLoader: after the RegisterAtlas call succeeds, compute checksum and call atlas.WriteBC7CacheAndReplaceTextures. To distinguish file vs memory loaders, pass the checksum computation as a Func<uint> parameter. For file-based: Func = () => WEChecksumUtils.ComputeFileListChecksum(imagePaths). Add a static ComputeFileListChecksum(string[] paths) that hashes full path + file size for each existing PNG. For memory-based: Func = () => WEChecksumUtils.ComputeBridgeMemoryChecksum(producer()). Cache file path: Path.Combine(CACHED_VT_FOLDER, atlasName + '.cache.we.bc7'). The smart-reload check in LoadImagesFromModsCoroutine should also skip rebuild when checksum matches cached file.
dod: RegisterImageAtlas (file-based) writes a .cache.we.bc7 file after atlas build
RegisterImageAtlasFromMemory (producer-based) writes a .cache.we.bc7 file after atlas build
LoadImagesFromModsCoroutine skips rebuild for unchanged atlases (checksum match)
ComputeFileListChecksum added: hashes full-path + filesize for each PNG
Test: bridge cache file lifecycle test (Ignored - Unity required)
